name: bugtongph
description: Conversational, gated production pipeline for Filipino bugtong episodes: Notion-backed riddle, location, environment, locked character/style/voice profiles, script, ingredient-sheet image, and copy-ready Google Flow / Veo 3.1 Lite clip prompts.

interface.longDescription: Conversational, checkpoint-safe production pipeline for Filipino bugtong episodes. Each stage offers options, asks one short question, and waits. Selects riddles only from the connected Notion bugtongPH Riddle Database, then locks location, environment, and one Character + Art Style + Voice profile, writes the script, plans the ingredient-sheet panels, shows a full overview, and only then generates and validates the image before emitting two copy-ready Google Flow / Veo 3.1 Lite prompts. Runs under explicit production, beta, and development channels.
defaultPrompt: .auto - run the bugtong episode pipeline one stage at a time, resuming the first incomplete checkpoint.
.riddle - pick a riddle from the Notion bugtongPH Riddle Database, then lock a location, environment, and profile.
.clips - turn a validated image into two copy-ready Google Flow / Veo prompts, one per clip.
